item.title: Karnataka - Wikipedia
item.description: Karnataka[a] is a state on the southwestern coast of India. It was formed as Mysore State on 1 November 1956, with the passage of the States Reorganisation Act, and renamed in 1973. item.title: Karnataka | History, Map, Capital, & Government | Britannica
item.description: Karnataka is a state of India, located on the western coast of the subcontinent. The state extends for about 420 miles from north to south and for about 300 miles from east to west. Its coastline stretches for some 200 miles. The capital is Bengaluru. Formerly known as Mysore, it took its present name in 1973.

item.title: Karnataka Government
item.description: The Karnataka Government on Monday issued new guidelines making wearing face masks and maintaining social distancing compulsory. The decision was taken at a meeting headed by Chief Minister Basavaraj Bommai with senior ministers, officials and the COVID-19 technical advisory committee consisting of experts.

item.title: History of Karnataka - Wikipedia
item.description: Karnataka was the part of the Maurya Empire, the first Mauryan Emperor Chandragupta Maurya died in Shravanbelgola in Hassan District around 298 BCE where he spent the last days of his life as a Jain ascetic. [19] Around 239 BCE, the Satavahana dynasty came to power and its rule lasted nearly four centuries, until the early 3rd century CE.
